annotation.title_clean: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2021/1341 of 23 April 2021 supplementing Regulation (EU) 2019/2144 ... type-approval of motor vehicles with regard to their driver drowsiness and attention warning systems
annotation.title_en: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2021/1341 on type-approval of motor vehicles with regard to driver drowsiness and attention warning systems
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union, L 292/4
annotation.summary_en: EU delegated regulation setting technical requirements and test procedures for type-approval of driver drowsiness and attention warning systems in M and N category vehicles above 70 km/h. It sets validation with human participants, KSS-based thresholds, sensitivity acceptance criteria, privacy constraints and technical service assessment. Applies from 6 July 2022.
key_provisions_or_claims: DDAW systems required for M and N vehicles with design speed above 70 km/h, applying from 6 July 2022
System must warn at KSS level 8 or above and cannot be manually deactivated
Must operate without biometric information or facial recognition; data processing must follow Union data protection law
Manufacturers must validate with at least 10 human participants; average sensitivity above 40% or lower confidence bound above 20%
Technical services assess documentation and run verification test protocol for type-approval
